items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: Our announcer told me, he said, your wife is beautiful.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. What's his name called? Roger's Base. No. Not the radio. No, they had the radio.
That's it. That's correct. Johnny Frankel. I didn't call his name to save my life.
